value.rationale: The 2024 motivating paper specifically asks what survives for nearly identical eigenvalues, and the subsequent 2025 study points out the invariant manifold need not persist. The theorem gives a globally valid replacement geometric constraint on every compact recurrent set even when exact dimension reduction fails: the sign of the drift is known, the width has a linear eigenvalue-splitting law with explicit factor, and its constant is sharp by an actual invariant orbit. Stationary measures obey an additional exact signed displacement law. This is a parameter-robustness structural lemma, not a renamed equality-case corollary, and explicitly does not claim attractor persistence.
